readout_other: hippocampal CA1 LFP and EMG; sleep staging, ripple/spindle density, spindle-ripple coupling, theta-gamma phase-amplitude coupling
direction_notes: Stimulation increased ripple density in all protocols; in-phase SO stimulation raised NREM and lowered wake ratio and enhanced spindle-ripple coupling, theta-phase stimulation weakened it; theta-high gamma coupling rose in REM in all protocols.

exposures.label: closed-loop TUS to hippocampus: SO in-phase, SO out-of-phase, theta peak, theta trough

timing.protocol_description: Phase-locked closed-loop stimulation: SD 50 ms for theta peak/trough stimulation in wake and 400 ms for slow-oscillation in-phase/out-of-phase stimulation in NREM; each stimulation period lasted 15 min, given daily over 4 days, with 3 h LFP recorded afterwards.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Experiment A (closed-loop stimulation, 30 mice): 12 mice were randomly divided into 2 groups (theta peak stimulation group [n 6], theta trough stimulation group [n 6]) for evaluating neural activities in sleep after theta phase-locked stimulation in wake.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: During 4-day stimulation period, we analyzed sleep structure, coupling of spindle–ripple in NREM and the coupling of the theta–gamma band in REM.
